summary: Epic Management is a third-generation, family-owned construction manager and design-build general contractor founded in Piscataway, NJ in 1971, operating from three offices (Piscataway, Manhattan, and Milford, CT) with a $400M surety relationship and affiliates Epic Interiors and Epic Millwork. It serves public and private owners across K-12/higher education, municipal, parking, data center, healthcare, pharmaceutical and liturgical work. Intake is phone and web-form based, subcontractor bidding runs through BuildingConnected, and the company posts no open jobs, taking resumes by email only.

facts.fact: Founded in 1971 in Piscataway, NJ by Robert (Bob) Epifano; the site claims third-generation family ownership, 55+ years in business and 65+ awards.
Provides program and construction management as consultant/agent, design-build, construction management and general construction, supported by a $400 million surety relationship.
Headquarters at 136 Eleventh Street, Piscataway, NJ 08854 ((732) 752-6100); additional offices at 45 Rockefeller Plaza, 20th Floor, New York, NY and 180 Wampus Lane, Milford, CT.

Affiliate Epic Interiors, LLC self-performs selective demolition, metal framing, drywall, ceilings and carpentry with a regular union crew of about 75 that expands to 200+; Epic Millwork fabricates and installs custom wood and laminate millwork.

In-house consulting services include scheduling, cost estimating, staff augmentation, PLA/labor consulting and facilities management; the firm states an EMR of 0.663 and experience in NJ, NY, CT, GA and FL over 50 years.

Safety program requires OSHA 30-hour training for all field staff, weekly safety meetings, daily planning sessions and pre-hire/random drug testing, and claims zero lost workdays in 2013-2025 and a 2019 NJ Governor's OSHA Safety Award.
The careers page lists no open positions and directs applicants to submit resumes by email to employment@epicbuilds.com.

Subcontractor bid opportunities are hosted on a public BuildingConnected portal; the footer also exposes an employee login on epicbuilds.dexterchaney.com and a client login on an FTP-style server (ftp.epicbuilds.com:8080).

Portfolio covers municipal/government, parking structures, data centers, fire stations, religious facilities, parks/golf and K-12/higher-ed projects, including Rutgers RWJBarnabas Athletic Health Performance Center and CUNY data center projects.
Leadership: Robert Epifano, Jr. is Chief Executive Officer; Bill Morris is President; Miguel Alayón is CFO (also heading IT and HR); Joel Lizotte is Executive Vice President.

The contact page offers per-region phone numbers and email addresses (marketing@, newyork@, newengland@epicbuilds.com) plus a web message form; the page description advertises work on the East Coast and in Puerto Rico.
A SimplyHired search for Epic Management jobs in Piscataway, NJ returned zero listings.

operations_signals: Project inquiries and RFQs arrive via phone numbers for each regional office, regional email aliases and a Gravity Forms web message form; no online booking, quote calculator or client self-service intake exists (https://www.epicbuilds.com/contact/).
Subcontractor bid solicitation and document distribution run through a public BuildingConnected portal rather than email or a proprietary plan room (https://www.epicbuilds.com/bid-opportunities/).

Client document access is a legacy FTP-style login (ftp.epicbuilds.com:8080) while staff log into Dexter + Chaney for accounting/operations, suggesting two disconnected document systems (https://www.epicbuilds.com/bid-opportunities/).
Recruiting and hiring intake is a single email alias with no applicant tracking system or posted requisitions (https://www.epicbuilds.com/contact/careers/).

Estimating is centralized: a Chief Estimator/Director of Purchasing coordinates hard-bid and concept estimates with a support team, implying a single queue for bid volume across all offices (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).

Service area is marketed as NJ/NY/CT plus project experience in GA and FL and work in Puerto Rico, so project teams are geographically distributed from three offices (https://www.epicbuilds.com/contact/).

Public-sector practice (state, county, municipal, parking authority, K-12, higher ed) implies formal bid, PLA and prevailing-wage compliance workflows handled by in-house staff (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).
hiring_signals: No open positions are posted on the company careers page; only a general invitation to email a resume, indicating no active or publicly tracked requisitions (https://www.epicbuilds.com/contact/careers/).
SimplyHired returns zero job listings for the company in Piscataway, NJ (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Epic+Management+Piscataway+NJ).

Team page shows 2024 additions of 'Account Executive' and 'CM Account Executive' positions, roles oriented toward client coordination and repeat-account management (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).
The Chief Estimator also serves as Director of Purchasing, a combined preconstruction/purchasing workload common where back-office capacity is thin (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).

Staff tenure is unusually long (many executives 20-38 years, several since the 1980s-1990s), so administrative workload is absorbed by a stable but small core rather than by growth hiring (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).
A Director of Marketing handles proposals and qualifications submissions in-house, pointing to a heavy recurring proposal/RFQ production load (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress (7.1.4) with Yoast SEO, Gravity Forms for the contact form, Google Tag Manager (GTM-PLM4H2J), AddThis share buttons and a Google Maps embed; no live-chat or chatbot script was observed (https://www.epicbuilds.com/contact/).
Bid management is on BuildingConnected, the Procore-owned subcontractor network (https://www.epicbuilds.com/bid-opportunities/).
Accounting/ERP and employee portal sit on Dexter + Chaney (epicbuilds.dexterchaney.com) (https://www.epicbuilds.com/bid-opportunities/).
Client document delivery uses an older FTP-backed login at ftp.epicbuilds.com:8080 rather than a modern project-management portal (https://www.epicbuilds.com/bid-opportunities/).

Portfolio and safety pages carry recent content (awards listed through 2025) but the news page is essentially a single image-based 'A Legacy Remembered' post with no article text (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/news/).

Social presence is linked from the footer (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X) but the site publishes no blog cadence, project data or downloadable content (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/news/).
growth_signals: Three-office footprint (Piscataway HQ, 45 Rockefeller Plaza in Manhattan, Milford CT) with a dedicated NYC regional director and New England regional contact (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/regional-offices/).
Work history spans NJ, NY, CT, GA and FL with marketing reference to Puerto Rico, indicating multi-state expansion beyond the home market (https://www.epicbuilds.com/service/consulting-services/).

Safety recognition sustained through 2025 (zero lost workdays 2013-2025, zero incidence rate on 50,000+ hours 2017-2025, NJ Governor's OSHA award 2019), a differentiator for public-sector prequalification (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/safety/).

Generational leadership transition: founder Bob Epifano is Chairman Emeritus, John Epifano is listed as President Emeritus (1968-2024) and third-generation Joe Epifano now serves as Project Manager (https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/).

Affiliate Epic Interiors can flex its union crew from about 75 to 200+ and bids work from $50,000 to $25 million, giving the group capacity to absorb larger or fast-turnaround awards (https://www.epicbuilds.com/affiliates/).

Portfolio spans large public programs (Bergen County agency building and garage, CUNY data centers, FDNY firehouse, Rutgers performance center), suggesting a book of many concurrent projects (https://www.epicbuilds.com/portfolios/).
decision_maker: Robert Epifano, Jr., Chief Executive Officer — https://www.epicbuilds.com/our-company/our-team/ (Bill Morris, President, same source)

inferences.inference: Bid and preconstruction administration is probably the heaviest repetitive workload, so an agent that drafts bid packages, scope matrices and RFI/submittal logs would hit real volume.
inferences.reasoning: The firm runs many concurrent public and private projects with a centralized Chief Estimator/Director of Purchasing and an in-house Director of Marketing producing all qualifications/proposal submissions; no estimating or proposal software beyond BuildingConnected is visible.

inferences.inference: Inbound inquiries likely go untriaged outside business hours because the only intake channels are phone numbers and an email-style web form.
inferences.reasoning: Contact page shows regional phone numbers, email aliases and a Gravity Form with no chat, booking, portal intake or published after-hours coverage.

inferences.inference: Recruiting is manual and slow: resumes land in one mailbox with no ATS, so screening, acknowledgment and pipeline tracking are human work.
inferences.reasoning: Careers page lists no requisitions and instructs applicants to email employment@epicbuilds.com; SimplyHired shows no listings, so there is no structured applicant flow.

inferences.inference: Document retrieval is a friction point for owners and subs because client access is an FTP-style login while bid documents live in BuildingConnected.
inferences.reasoning: Footer exposes two separate login systems (Dexter + Chaney employee portal and ftp.epicbuilds.com:8080 client storage) plus the BuildingConnected portal.

inferences.inference: Technology adoption decisions are concentrated in the CFO/CEO, which shortens the sales path but raises the bar for security and ROI evidence.
inferences.reasoning: Miguel Alayón is CFO and also heads information technology and HR, and CEO Robert Epifano, Jr. is described as owning financial, technological, administrative and risk management.

inferences.inference: Public-sector prequalification and safety reporting create recurring compliance documentation work that could be largely automated.
inferences.reasoning: Safety page lists years of OSHA/BCANJ award data, zero-incidence statistics, training records and drug-testing programs that must be assembled repeatedly for bids and audits.

data_gaps: No public review corpus could be retrieved: Glassdoor, Indeed, Yelp, ZipRecruiter and D&B all returned HTTP 403 and BBB returned only a cookie notice, so review_themes is empty rather than inferred.

General web search was unavailable during this run (provider rate limits and a search backend returning unrelated 'Epic' results), so job-board coverage is limited to the careers page and SimplyHired.
Employee headcount, revenue, project backlog and number of active projects are not published; size can only be approximated from the $400M surety capacity and affiliate crew figures.
No stated business hours, after-hours or emergency coverage, response-time commitments, or client-portal documentation were found on the site.
The news page's 'A Legacy Remembered' item is image-only, so its content (apparently about John Epifano, 1968-2024) could not be read directly.
D&B profile listed in the mapper sources was inaccessible (403), so no third-party firmographic verification was possible.
